seoTitle: How to Permanently Delete a Google Workspace Account
metaDescription: Step-by-step guide to permanently deleting your Google Workspace account in 2026, including canceling billing and removing your domain cleanly.
intro: Permanently deleting a Google Workspace account removes all user data, Gmail, and Drive files, so it's a step to take carefully when closing a business or switching platforms. This guide covers the full process so nothing is left behind and you avoid unexpected charges.

steps.heading: Back up important data first
steps.body: Before deleting anything, export or download critical emails, Drive files, and contacts since deletion is irreversible.

steps.heading: Cancel your subscription
steps.body: Go to the Admin Console's billing section and cancel your active Workspace subscription before attempting to delete the account.

steps.heading: Remove your domain from the account
steps.body: Detach or remove any associated domains, which is often required before the account can be fully deleted.

steps.heading: Initiate the account deletion
steps.body: Once billing is canceled and domains are cleared, use the account closure option in the Admin Console to start final deletion.

steps.heading: Watch for common deletion errors
steps.body: Deletion can fail if there are still active services or pending payments, so resolve any outstanding items before trying again.

faq.question: Can I recover my Google Workspace account after permanent deletion?
faq.answer: No, once the deletion process fully completes, the account and its data cannot be recovered, which is why backing up beforehand is essential.

faq.question: Do I need to cancel my subscription before deleting the account?
faq.answer: Yes, canceling your subscription is typically a required first step before the Admin Console will let you proceed with account deletion.

faq.question: Why might my Google Workspace deletion fail?
faq.answer: Deletion commonly fails due to active services, unresolved billing, or a domain still attached to the account — clear these first.

faq.question: How long does it take to permanently delete a Workspace account?
faq.answer: The process can take anywhere from a few minutes to several days depending on outstanding services and how quickly related steps are resolved.
